name: notebooklm-curator
description: Keeps your NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook) library fresh: adds new videos from YouTube channels you follow, flags stale sources, removes nothing without your approval.
long_description:
NotebookLM Curator lets Claude manage your NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) notebooks through a Chrome window on your own computer.

- Follow a YouTube channel or playlist and get its new videos added to a notebook.
- Audit a notebook: every source gets a shelf life by category (news, tactics, tools, tutorials, principles) and stale ones are flagged.
- Remove sources, only after you approve each title.
- List notebooks and sources, create and rename notebooks, add links, ask questions.

Requires Google Chrome on Windows or macOS. On first use, ask Claude to set it up: it opens Chrome once so you can sign in to Google. A YouTube API key is optional and only needed for publish dates in audits.

Not affiliated with Google or Anthropic.

tools.name: nlm_setup
tools.description: Checks what is ready and explains the next setup step.

tools.name: nlm_auth
tools.description: Opens Chrome once so you can sign in to Google.

tools.name: nlm_list_sources
tools.description: Lists the sources in a notebook.

tools.name: nlm_audit
tools.description: Flags stale sources by shelf life. Deletes nothing.

tools.name: nlm_remove_source
tools.description: Removes a source you approved by title.

tools.name: nlm_add_source
tools.description: Adds a web page or YouTube link as a source.

tools.name: nlm_watch_source
tools.description: Follows a YouTube channel or playlist for a notebook.

tools.name: nlm_manage_watches
tools.description: Lists, pauses, resumes, updates or removes watches.

tools.name: nlm_sync_watches
tools.description: Checks watched channels for new videos now.

tools.name: nlm_list_candidates
tools.description: Lists new videos waiting for review.

tools.name: nlm_approve_candidates
tools.description: Adds the new videos you approved.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube API key (optional)
youtube_api_key.description: Leave empty to start. Only needed to look up publish dates when auditing a notebook. The README explains how to get a free key.
